rationale.conceptual: The method uses established components (finite element, harmonic-mean threshold, recursive ray-tracing) but the combination is non-trivial and requires careful implementation of the described algorithms, including interpolation, refraction, and PSF validation. It is not a single textbook operation, nor is it a completely novel research-grade algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has at least 7 stages with dependencies, including an external finite element solver (CalculiX) that must be set up with specific boundary conditions, meshing, and output parsing. The ray-tracing must be implemented from scratch. The orchestration is fragile and involves multiple tool handoffs.
